Subject: Renewal quotes: laptops + CoWorkHub seat changes (Q2)

Hi team,

We have vendor quotes back for the Q2 refresh and a small seat reshuffle at CoWorkHub. Summary: 
- BrightLaptops: 60 units (MacBook Air M2 equivalent) lease vs one-time purchase. Quote attached. (Attachment: BL-quote-20260307.pdf)
- CoWorkHub: adjust 12 seats from downtown site B -> site A; monthly delta +$4,200. Rate card attached. (Attachment: CW-ratecard-20260305.pdf)
- TechShip Logistics flagged potential expedited-shipping surcharge for 20/40 shipments; they need delivery windows for imaging.

Ask: Can IT confirm imaging/asset-tagging plan and estimated time-on-desk for staged shipping? Finance: can we approve the purchase route vs lease for cost/CapEx reasons? Legal: are there any standard T&C redlines we should worry about?

If we can align this week, I'd like to route PO to BrightLaptops and lock the CoWorkHub adjustment before March 15.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

On Mon, Mar 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> We have vendor quotes back for the Q2 refresh and a small seat reshuffle at CoWorkHub.
> 
> Ask: Can IT confirm imaging/asset-tagging plan and estimated time-on-desk for staged shipping?

Quick yes from IT: specs in the BL quote look good. Two notes:
- We need asset tags applied before leaving vendor warehouse; TechShip can do this if we provide CSV.
- Imaging: standard MDM image takes ~45 minutes per device. For 60 units we can stage 6/day with one ops tech (so 10 days). Expedited shipping will reduce lead time but increase cost.

Recommend: request vendor to ship in two batches (30/30) and schedule TechShip pickup after imaging windows. I can own coordination.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of IT Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Thanks, Monica and Marcus.

A few action items: 
1) Marcus, proceed with the two-batch plan and confirm TechShip can do asset-tagging (they said maybe). Please get exact surcharge numbers for expedited option.
2) Monica, prepare a PO for BrightLaptops (PO-78321) for 60 units purchase option; include staged shipping instructions.
3) Laura, finance: please confirm CapEx vs OpEx preference. If we go purchase route, we need AP ready to process PO and net-30 invoice.
4) Rishi, can you glance at BL's standard terms and CoWorkHub amendment? Looking for data deletion clause and liability limits.

I want to minimize total cost while keeping 2-week lead time if possible.

Thanks — invoice attached and PO noted. We can do two batches (30/30). Pricing reflects the purchase option in the quoted doc. Attachments: PO-78321-invoice.pdf, shipping_manifest_78321.csv.

TechShip: we can hand off palletized shipments to you at our Oakland warehouse. They require recipient contact, delivery window, and whether Redwood needs on-site imaging. We can preload images if you provide MDM profile via secure link.

Let us know how you want to proceed.

- Provide asset-tag CSV and MDM profile URL at least 48 hours before pickup.
- For on-site imaging we charge an additional $35/device; warehouse pre-loading is free if you provide the image.
- ETA to Redwood HQ (San Francisco) from Oakland is next-business-day for standard shipping. Expedited moves to same-day courier.

Please confirm whether Redwood wants TechShip to apply asset tags and whether we should schedule imaging at our facility.
